stories.headline: Spanish citizen evacuated from hantavirus-hit cruise ship tests positive
stories.summary: A Spanish citizen evacuated from the hantavirus-hit cruise ship MV Hondius has tested positive for the virus. The individual is currently isolating at a hospital in Madrid. This development comes after the last passengers left the cruise ship, with authorities confirming three new positive cases linked to the outbreak. The MV Hondius had been at the center of a deadly hantavirus outbreak, prompting evacuations and isolation measures. The Spanish national's positive test result is the latest update in the ongoing situation, which has raised concerns about the spread of the virus. The hospital in Madrid is taking necessary precautions to treat the patient and prevent further transmission. The incident highlights the need for continued monitoring and response to the hantavirus outbreak.

stories.headline: Gates Foundation commits $15m to combat Ebola outbreak in DRC, Uganda
stories.summary: The Gates Foundation has committed $15 million in emergency funding to support containment efforts for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The funding aims to combat the rising infections and deaths in the region. With over 900 suspected cases, according to the World Health Organisation (WHO), the outbreak has raised concerns of cross-border spread. The $15 million will be disbursed through trusted institutions already working on the ground in the affected areas. This approach is designed to allocate the majority of resources directly to the affected countries and communities, supporting response efforts and helping to contain the outbreak. The funding is an initial commitment, indicating the foundation's support for the international response to the Ebola crisis in the DRC and Uganda.

stories.headline: African producers risk losing up to $11 billion in annual EU export revenue if sustainability rules are not met, experts warn
stories.summary: African producers face a potential loss of up to $11 billion in annual EU export revenue if they fail to meet new sustainability rules. The European Union has implemented stricter regulations, and non-compliance may result in significant economic losses for African countries. The warning comes as the EU is already facing economic challenges, including a potential loss of €400 billion in tourism revenue. The 2025 African Economic Outlook report highlights the impact of shifting global trade policies on African economies. The report notes that major economies have made significant changes to their trade policies, affecting the global trade order. African countries must adapt to these changes to maintain their export revenue and avoid economic losses. The new sustainability rules require African producers to meet certain standards to continue exporting to the EU.

stories.headline: Boy, 9, among children cautioned after trouble in Derry
stories.summary: Three children, aged 9, 12, and 13, were detained and cautioned by the Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) after trouble in the Galliagh area of Derry. The incident involved masked youths damaging a bus stop and throwing petrol bombs and other missiles. The boys were taken into custody and later released to their parents after being cautioned. The incident occurred in the Galliagh area, where reports of disorderly behavior and vandalism were made. The PSNI responded to the situation, detaining the three boys and issuing cautions. The children were then returned to their parents, marking the end of the police involvement in the incident. The ages of the children involved have raised concerns about youth involvement in public disorder.

stories.headline: Your hardware's real performance is locked behind BIOS settings you've never seen
stories.summary: Users can unlock their hardware's full performance by adjusting BIOS settings that are often overlooked. To access these settings, navigate to the Advanced section of the BIOS, typically by pressing F7 on most motherboards. This section may be labeled as OC/Tweaker, AI Tweaker, Extreme Tweaker, or Advanced Memory. Optimizing BIOS settings can significantly improve hardware performance, but many users are unaware of these options. To find specific settings for their motherboard, users can search online for their exact motherboard model and visit the manufacturer's support page for the latest BIOS updates and documentation. By exploring and adjusting these settings, users can potentially unlock their hardware's true capabilities and enhance overall system performance. This process requires some technical knowledge, but can be done with proper research and guidance.

stories.headline: Mobile communication without network coverage or fees: How Meshtastic works
stories.summary: Meshtastic is a LoRa-based mesh networking protocol and software platform that enables low-power, long-range communication over ISM radio bands without requiring a license. The technology allows for wireless communication with no fees or contract, transmitting data over longer distances depending on the configuration. In a Meshtastic mesh network, every device acts as both a transmitter and a repeater, automatically routing messages through multiple nodes until they reach their destination. This off-grid network is useful for situations where traditional cellular and internet coverage is limited, such as hiking, deploying sensors in remote locations, or experimenting with resilient networks. Meshtastic's mesh network model differs from traditional cell networks, which use a "hub and spoke" model, providing a reliable alternative for communication in areas with limited or no network coverage. The range of compatible devices is relatively large, making it a viable option for various applications.

stories.headline: Beckman Coulter Life Sciences Commercialises Echo 650 Plus Series For Next Generation Acoustic Liquid Handling
stories.summary: Beckman Coulter Life Sciences has commercialized the Echo 650 Plus Series, a next-generation acoustic liquid handling platform. The new series combines AI-driven fluid analysis, improved acoustic precision, and reduced power consumption. It offers 54% lower power consumption compared to the legacy Echo 650 Series. The Echo 650 Plus Series provides high-throughput, non-contact, accurate, and precise liquid dispensing with volumes as low as 2.5 nL. The platform features machine learning-enabled DFA2 and delivers significantly faster real-time computation. The commercial release of the Echo 650 Plus Series aims to enhance reliability, efficiency, and performance in acoustic liquid handling applications. The new series is designed to meet the evolving needs of laboratories and research institutions, offering improved functionality and reduced environmental impact.

stories.headline: Samsung is renaming the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Wide Fold: report
stories.summary: Samsung is reportedly renaming its upcoming foldable phones, with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Wide Fold to be branded as the "Galaxy Z Fold 8" and "Z Fold 8 Ultra". The wider phone, expected to compete with Apple's rumored iPhone Ultra foldable, is set to launch on July 22 at Samsung's Unpacked event, along with the standard Z Fold 8 and Galaxy Z Flip 8. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra will feature new camera technology, differing from the Apple iPhone Fold in at least one key way. The launch event may also include the unveiling of the Samsung Galaxy Watch 9. The new naming scheme and launch details have not been officially confirmed by Samsung, but multiple leaks and reports suggest the company is preparing to release its latest foldable devices in select global markets in July.

stories.headline: Titans' Will Levis spent 'exorbitant' amount to make sex tape 'go away'
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans backup quarterback Will Levis paid a significant amount of money to remove an intimate sex tape from the internet. The tape, featuring Levis and his college girlfriend, was leaked after his personal device was hacked by an Eastern European group. According to his mother, Beth, Levis hired a cybersecurity specialist and private investigator to try and resolve the issue, spending an "exorbitant" amount in the process. The incident occurred separately from Levis's recent decision to undergo season-ending surgery on his right shoulder, which will allow rookie Cam Ward to take first-team reps in training camp. Levis's mother spoke out about the leaked tape in a recent interview, discussing her son's efforts to address the situation. The exact amount spent by Levis has not been disclosed.

stories.headline: Shelton starts on song American fifth seed enjoys lively Paris conditions on way to round two
stories.summary: American fifth seed Ben Shelton advanced to the second round of the French Open with a dominant win in straight sets. Shelton's trademark serve proved decisive, winning 86% of points behind his first serve in the one-hour, 40-minute contest. This marks a strong start to his campaign, building on his steadily improving track record at the French Open. In his first appearance in 2023, Shelton lost in the first round, but he has since gained experience on clay. Fellow American favorites Amanda Anisimova and Frances Tiafoe also progressed to the second round. Shelton's win comes as other top players, like Casper Ruud, faced more challenging opening tests, with Ruud battling past Roman Safiullin in a grueling five-set match. Shelton will look to continue his momentum in the next round.

stories.headline: Eng vs NZ, 3rd T20I - Dani Gibson gives England World Cup boost
stories.summary: England secured a 2-1 T20I series win over New Zealand with a commanding performance in the third match. Dani Gibson played a key role, reprising her allrounder position to give England a boost ahead of the Women's T20 World Cup. Alongside Charlie Dean, Gibson helped restrict New Zealand to 80 runs, setting up a comfortable English win. The series victory is a positive sign for England as they prepare for the World Cup, with their established core and comeback players looking to make an impact. Gibson's performance is particularly noteworthy, as it demonstrates her ability to contribute in multiple ways and provides a timely confidence boost for the team.

stories.headline: Kilkenny have to learn lessons from Rebel regeneration Some 18 players from Cork's 2021 Under-20 All-Ireland-winning squad made it into the senior changing room in some capacity
stories.summary: Cork's 2021 Under-20 All-Ireland-winning squad has seen 18 players transition into the senior team. This depth of talent was on display as Cork won their first All-Ireland U23A camogie title, defeating Kilkenny 2-23 to 1-5 at Cappoquin Logistics Fraher Field. The Cork team featured experienced players, including multiple All-Ireland senior medallists Orlaith Cahalane and Méabh Murphy. The significant margin of victory highlights the strength of Cork's squad and the need for Kilkenny to learn from their opponents' successful regeneration of talent. Cork's ability to integrate young players into their senior team has paid dividends, and Kilkenny will likely look to replicate this model to remain competitive. The loss serves as a lesson for Kilkenny to reassess their approach to developing young talent.

stories.headline: Twisha Sharma death: SC pained by handling of case, asks media to exercise restraint; CBI team dispatched to Bhopal
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has expressed pain over the handling of the Twisha Sharma death case and asked the media to exercise restraint in reporting. A CBI team has been dispatched to Bhopal to take over the investigation. The 33-year-old woman was found dead at her in-laws' home in Bhopal on May 12, six months after her marriage to Samarth Singh, a lawyer and son of a retired judge. The Supreme Court had earlier transferred the probe to the CBI, citing the need for an impartial investigation amid bias allegations. The court's directive to the media comes as the CBI prepares to investigate the case, with the parents of the deceased demanding a second post-mortem report. The CBI's involvement aims to ensure a fair and unbiased investigation into the circumstances surrounding Twisha Sharma's death.

stories.headline: Rubio asked about Trump's hellhole remark against India. What he said
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio was questioned about Donald Trump's "hellhole" remark regarding India, which Trump shared on his Truth Social platform. The comment, originally made by podcaster Michael Savage, prompted India's government to denounce it as "in poor taste". Rubio sidestepped the question, claiming unfamiliarity with the context, and instead stated that Trump remains a strong admirer of India and Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The incident occurred in April, and a viral video of Rubio's response sparked controversy during his visit to India. The US State Department later deleted a clip of Rubio's remarks, which were criticized for not adequately addressing the issue of racist comments against Indians in the US. Rubio's response came amid criticism over alleged anti-India rhetoric in the United States.

stories.headline: NDTV Nava Punjab Summit Live: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann, Chief Secretary KAP Sinha and DGP Gaurav Yadav are among the key figures speaking at th
stories.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann, Chief Secretary KAP Sinha, and DGP Gaurav Yadav are speaking at the NDTV Nava Punjab Summit in Chandigarh. The summit brings together leaders, policymakers, cultural icons, and changemakers to discuss Punjab's governance, economic ambitions, and social priorities. The state is at a critical juncture, balancing growth, jobs, industry, agriculture, innovation, and identity in a rapidly changing India. At the summit, Chief Minister Mann stated that the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) is a national party and its leader, Arvind Kejriwal, does not interfere in the government's decision-making process. The event aims to explore Punjab's path forward, addressing key challenges and opportunities in the state's development. Key figures are sharing their insights and perspectives on the state's future, focusing on governance, economy, and social issues.

stories.headline: Iran throws architectural shade on Marco Rubio's hot Taj Mahal visit India News: TOI correspondent from Washington: In a week already overloaded with US-Iran peace talks, energy crises, and the aftermath of Trump visit to China
stories.summary: Iran's Consulate in Hyderabad criticized US Senator Marco Rubio's visit to the Taj Mahal, stating that if he knew the monument's history and architecture, he wouldn't have posed for a picture. The consulate highlighted the Taj Mahal's Persian architectural roots, noting it was built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his Persian wife, Mumtaz Mahal. The post claimed Rubio's government threatens to wipe out Iranian civilization, despite him appreciating a monument linked to Persian heritage. The criticism comes amid US-Iran peace talks, with delegations from both countries negotiating a deal to end the ongoing conflict. The consulate's post also showcased Persia's influence on Mughal architecture in India, sparking a viral reaction on social media. Rubio had earlier joked about the Taj Mahal, referencing Trump's former casino in Atlantic City.

stories.headline: EXARCHOU SOUNDS ALARM: Elefsina Port Turns Into Greece’s New Energy Stronghold AKTOR chief warns of a difficult winter for Europe as LNG, geopolitics and new ports reshape the balance of power
stories.summary: Alexandros Exarchou, AKTOR chief, warned of a difficult winter for Europe due to LNG, geopolitics, and new ports reshaping the balance of power. His statement at the Blue Strategy Summit 2026 sent shockwaves through Greece's political and energy circles. Greece is transforming Elefsina into a logistics hub, backed by the US, as an alternative to the Chinese-controlled Port of Piraeus. The AKTOR Group and DEPA Commercial have established a joint venture for LNG trading, positioning Greece as a key European energy hub. The development of the Elefsina port is seen as a strategic counterweight to Chinese influence in the region. Exarchou's recent meetings at the White House highlight the importance the US places on its energy relations with Greece, underscoring the country's growing role in European energy developments. The project aims to establish Greece as a major energy player amid geopolitical shifts.

stories.headline: Kyiv’s Drone Diplomacy Makes Ukraine A Power In Global Geopolitics Ukraine's drone innovations reinvented modern warfare and redefined superpower influence
stories.summary: Ukraine's expertise in drone warfare has become a significant diplomatic asset, allowing the country to boost its global influence. President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has leveraged this expertise to secure successful diplomatic deals during visits to the Middle East and Europe. Ukraine's drone innovations have reinvented modern warfare, and the country is now using its military prowess to seal deals for drone sales and tech-sharing. This shift has transformed Ukraine's position from seeking assistance to being a desirable security partner. The country's advances in drone technology have become a key factor in its diplomatic efforts, enabling it to redefine its role in global geopolitics and potentially replace the need for ground troops in conflict zones, such as Iran. Ukraine's drone diplomacy has elevated its status as a major player in international relations.

stories.headline: US and China Engage in High-Stakes Diplomacy Amid Rising Tensions
stories.summary: The US and China are engaging in high-stakes diplomacy amid rising tensions. President Donald Trump is set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping to negotiate on key issues including Taiwan, trade, and the fragile US-China relationship. The meeting follows recent discussions between Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng and US officials, where both sides expressed concern over US trade restrictions but committed to collaboration. At a previous summit, Xi emphasized the importance of a stable relationship between the two nations, stating that the US and China should be "partners, not rivals." The talks aim to resolve trade issues and ease tensions before they escalate further. Experts have shared insights on the recent high-stakes meetings in Beijing, highlighting the need for a more enduring trade deal to address existing geopolitical tensions. The outcome of the Trump-Xi meeting is expected to have significant implications for global affairs.

stories.headline: NATO Allies Strengthen Military Presence in Eastern Europe Amid Russian Aggression
stories.summary: NATO has increased its military presence in Eastern Europe in response to Russia's aggressive actions. The alliance has deployed additional troops and equipment, including tanks in Lithuania, to strengthen its eastern flank. The move is a direct result of Russia's behavior, particularly its invasion of Ukraine in 2022. US forces stationed in Poland play a critical role in the defense of NATO's eastern flank. Nordic countries have also ramped up their military presence, with Sweden officially joining NATO. The increased military presence aims to reassure nervous allies and deter potential Russian aggression. NATO's efforts to beef up its presence in Eastern Europe reflect a commitment to protecting its members and maintaining regional security. The alliance's actions demonstrate a strong response to the changed European security landscape following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

stories.headline: Stock market today: Sensex rose 1074 pts to close at 76,489 and Nifty added 312 pts to settle at 24,031. Nifty crossed the 24,000 mark for the first time since
stories.summary: The Sensex rose 1074 points to close at 76,489, and the Nifty added 312 points to settle at 24,031, crossing the 24,000 mark for the first time. This marked the highest closing levels for the benchmark indices since May 8. The gains added over Rs 6 lakh crore to the total market capitalisation of all companies listed on the BSE, taking it to around Rs 469 lakh crore. The rally was driven by broad-based buying across sectors and strong participation from broader markets. The Nifty registered an intraday high of 24,054.45, with buying momentum strengthening significantly in the second half of the session. According to Ajit Mishra, SVP, Research at Religare Broking, the Nifty may gradually inch toward the 24,400-24,600 zone in the near term.

stories.headline: Indian stock markets ended sharply higher with Sensex surging over 1,000 points and Nifty closing above 24,000. Falling crude oil prices, easing West Asia tensions
stories.summary: Indian stock markets ended sharply higher, with the Sensex surging over 1,000 points and the Nifty closing above 24,000 at 24,031.70. The rally was driven by falling crude oil prices, a stronger rupee, and easing tensions between the US and Iran, which boosted investor confidence. Broad-based buying was seen across sectors, with the Sensex rising 1,073 points. The improved market sentiment was also reflected in a fall in the volatility index, indicating easing fear among investors and improved risk appetite. The Nifty's crossing of the 24,000 mark is seen as a key hurdle overcome, with analysts noting the market's positive response to the potential US-Iran peace agreement and favorable global cues. The surge in Indian equity markets marks a significant gain, driven by a combination of domestic and global factors.

stories.headline: Stock market today: Which are top gainers and losers on NSE & BSE on May 25? Check list India Business News: Stock market rallied sharply on Monday, with the Sensex soaring more than 1,000 points and the Nifty reclaiming the 24,000 mark, as easing
stories.summary: The Indian stock market rallied sharply on May 25, with the Sensex soaring over 1,000 points and the Nifty reclaiming the 24,000 mark. This surge was driven by easing geopolitical tensions in West Asia and falling crude oil prices. The top gainers on the NSE and BSE included various stocks that saw significant increases in their share prices. The list of top gainers can be found on financial websites such as The Economic Times, NDTV Profit, and Rediff MoneyWiz, which provide live updates and data on the stock market. These platforms offer information on the top gainers and losers, along with their share prices, percentage changes, and trading volumes, helping investors stay informed and make informed decisions. The market's positive trend was a notable development, with many stocks experiencing significant gains.

stories.headline: Stock Market Highlights: Nifty Closes Above 24,000; Sensex Logs Best Rally In Six Weeks Nifty FMCG declined 0.16%, the only sector trading in the red. Nifty Pharma was largely flat, showing minimal movement during the session.
stories.summary: Indian stock markets ended sharply higher, with the Sensex surging 1,074 points to 76,488.96 and the Nifty closing above 24,000 at 24,031.70. The rally was driven by rising hopes of a US-Iran peace deal, falling oil prices, and other factors that boosted market sentiment. The Sensex jumped 1.42%, while the Nifty 50 surged 1.32%. Investors earned around ₹6 lakh crore. All sectors except Nifty FMCG, which declined 0.16%, traded in the green. Nifty Pharma was largely flat, showing minimal movement during the session. The significant gains marked the Sensex's best rally in six weeks, with the market opening in the green and maintaining positive gains throughout the trading day. The upbeat market sentiment led to a substantial increase in investor earnings.

stories.headline: Enbridge to Develop $1.2 Billion Solar & Storage Project to Power Meta Data Centers Canada-based energy infrastructure company Enbridge announced a new $1.2 billion solar and battery energy storage (BESS) project in Wyoming to support tech giant
stories.summary: Enbridge, a Canada-based energy infrastructure company, is developing a $1.2 billion solar and battery energy storage project in Wyoming. The project, located near Cheyenne, will support Meta data centers and is the first phase of the joint Cowboy Project. Tesla will provide the batteries for the project. This partnership between Enbridge and Meta aims to develop 1.6 GW of solar, wind, and storage capacity, with this project being a significant step towards that goal. The Wyoming project is a notable investment in renewable energy and energy storage, highlighting the growing trend of companies transitioning to cleaner power sources to support their operations. The project's development is expected to contribute to a more sustainable energy future.

stories.headline: Europe’s Gas Prices Drop 5% On Renewed U.S.-Iran Talks Optimism European natural gas prices fell more than 5% to around €46.3 per megawatt hour, their lowest level in two weeks, amid optimism that the United States and Iran
stories.summary: European natural gas prices dropped 5% to €46.3 per megawatt hour, the lowest in two weeks, due to optimism over renewed US-Iran talks. The potential deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz contributed to the decline. TTF prices fell further, plunging 8% to below €43 per megawatt hour on Wednesday. Global oil prices also decreased, with Brent crude falling 4.62% to $98.76 per barrel, a two-week low. The decline in oil prices is attributed to growing optimism surrounding a potential US-Iran agreement, which outweighed supply concerns. The developments come as the US weighs its next steps in the conflict with Iran, with diplomatic progress potentially leading to a deal. The price drops reflect the market's response to the renewed talks and potential easing of tensions between the US and Iran.

stories.headline: Tesla’s chief designer says its second-generation Roadster will be built in Texas. During a recent episode of Ryan McCaffrey’s Ride the Lightning podcast, Tesla’s chief designer, Franz von Holzhausen, confirmed its second-gen Roadster
stories.summary: Tesla's chief designer, Franz von Holzhausen, confirmed that the second-generation Roadster will be built in Texas. The announcement was made during a recent episode of the Ride the Lightning podcast. The second-gen Roadster has been in testing since its original unveiling in 2017. Von Holzhausen, who was a lead designer on the project, shared the update during a special podcast episode. The decision to manufacture the vehicle in Texas aligns with Tesla's existing operations in the state. The company has been expanding its presence in Texas, and the production of the Roadster will be another addition to its manufacturing capabilities in the region. The exact timeline for the production of the second-gen Roadster has not been disclosed, but the confirmation of its testing and Texas-based production provides an update on the vehicle's development status.

stories.headline: With payroll launch, Bujeti just made the HR-finance chaos obsolete #FeaturedPost | Business Insider Africa
stories.summary: Bujeti has launched a payroll system, making HR-finance chaos obsolete for African businesses. The significance of this launch lies not in the novelty of payroll, but in its integration within the same system already used by African businesses. This development aims to streamline HR and finance processes, eliminating chaos and inefficiencies. The launch is seen as a consequential move, given the existing user base of Bujeti's system. By building payroll into their existing platform, Bujeti is providing a comprehensive solution for African businesses to manage their HR and financial operations seamlessly. This integration is expected to simplify payroll management and reduce administrative burdens for businesses across the continent.
